name: net.isitdns/isitdns
title: isitdns
description: Is it DNS? Audit a site or domain that isn't working: one call says if it resolves and why. No key.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check a domain that is not working: whether the name resolves in public DNS, then the eleven-check audit of its zone, each row ok, warn, fail or skipped with why. DNS only, not HTTP or TLS. Measured from the isitdns edge and its probes, never the caller's network. from moves the recursion, TTL and UDP truncation rows to that region's probe.

name.description: The domain to audit, e.g. example.com. Send as name or domain; a URL is read as its host.

from.description: Region of the probe for the recursion, TTL and UDP truncation rows

tools.name: dig
tools.description: Dig one name and type at one resolver on the board (the resolvers isitdns monitors), or at Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 and AdGuard side by side (resolver all): records, flags, rcode, EDE, latency. Asked over DoH from the isitdns edge. from moves the question to that region's probe as Do53 over UDP, and follow: true adds the CNAME chain as separate reads with DNSSEC off. A resolver given as an address must be on the board.

name.description: The name, e.g. _dmarc.example.com. Send as name or domain; a URL is read as its host.

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, MX, TXT, DS, HTTPS, or TYPE<n>

resolver.description: A board resolver id (cloudflare, google, quad9, opendns, adguard, cleanbrowsing, controld, quad9-unfiltered, adguard-family, cleanbrowsing-family, adguard-unfiltered, opendns-familyshield, nextdns, cloudflare-malware, cloudflare-family, dns4eu-protective), its address or host name (8.8.8.8, dns.google), or all for cloudflare, google, quad9, adguard side by side. nextdns publishes no DoH: ask it with from.

dnssec.description: Set the DO bit and read AD

cd.description: Ask the resolver not to validate

family.description: Address family for Do53 dials; a DoH request does not choose it

from.description: Ask over Do53/UDP from the probe in this region (no other transport)

follow.description: Also walk the CNAME chain from this name, hop by hop, to its addresses

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Trace a delegation from the root to the authority: each referral and its glue, the one server that answered at each zone cut and any dial that failed, the final answer and its TTLs. Each hop is asked with RD=0 over TCP from the isitdns edge or a probe, named on the hop. Give the full host name: the walk ends at the zone that answers for it, and type (default A) is what it asks there.

name.description: The name to walk, e.g. www.example.com. Send as name or domain; a URL is read as its host.

type.description: Record type for the final question

tools.name: dnssec_chain
tools.description: Walk the DNSSEC chain from the root to one answer for a validation failure or key change: DS and DNSKEY at each signed zone cut, key tags, signers, signature windows, the first link that breaks or goes insecure, and whether that insecure zone is itself signed (an island of security). Read through Cloudflare's resolver over DoH with CD=1 from the isitdns edge, and a DNSKEY set that a break depends on is read again through Google's. Signature bytes are not verified, so a clean walk does not prove the answer validates. type (default A) is the record checked at the end, not OPT, RRSIG or a meta type such as ANY, and anchor (a DS or DNSKEY record, with anchor_zone) starts the walk at that zone instead of the root.

name.description: The name, e.g. www.example.com. Send as name or domain; a URL is read as its host.

type.description: The record type to check at the end of the chain

anchor.description: A trust anchor: "DS <key tag> <algorithm> <digest type> <digest>" or "DNSKEY <flags> <protocol> <algorithm> <key>", optionally led by its owner name

anchor_zone.description: The zone the anchor belongs to: the name or a parent of it. Optional when the anchor record leads with its owner

tools.name: sweep_domain
tools.description: Sweep a zone's nameservers: the same names and types asked at a sample of its authoritative addresses, reporting disagreements, lame or silent servers, serial and TTL differences, the CAA in effect, and each _acme-challenge TXT or CNAME. Asked with RD=0 over TCP from the isitdns edge or a probe, named on each answer. Every question not asked is listed with why, and an answer past 22,000 bytes is trimmed with counts, the whole sweep at its api: URL. names are labels under domain (@ for domain itself), 16 at most, and types 8 at most.

domain.description: The zone or name to sweep, e.g. example.com. Send as name or domain; a URL is read as its host.

names.description: Labels under domain, "@" for domain itself. Default: @, www, _dmarc, _acme-challenge

types.description: Record types. Default: SOA, NS, A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CAA

tools.name: registration
tools.description: Read whether a domain is expired or on hold from its registry's RDAP server: each status with what it means for resolution, the registration, expiry and change dates, the nameservers, whether the delegation is signed. Read over HTTPS from the isitdns edge through IANA's RDAP bootstrap, and no contacts are returned. A hostname is read at the name, then each parent down to the registered domain, and each HTTP read is listed with its URL, status and time.

domain.description: The domain or a hostname under it, e.g. example.com. Send as name or domain; a URL is read as its host.
